name: P8 · Supplier price list (form upload -> validate -> apply)

parameters.formDescription: Upload the supplier price list as CSV or XLSX. Needed columns: a price column and a SKU or product-name column. Every valid row is applied in one transaction; you get a summary email with a rejects file (one reason per row). Demo store with synthetic data.

parameters.query: select sku, name from products order by sku;

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ (r => r.file_error ? 'File rejected: ' + r.file_error + '. Nothing was changed.' : r.rows_changed + ' price(s) updated, ' + r.rows_unchanged + ' unchanged, ' + r.rows_rejected + ' rejected, ' + r.rows_review + ' AI suggestion(s) to review. A summary email with the details was sent.')($('Build summary').first().json.report) }}
